subject: CloudSage high-volume initiative — exec sign-off for exceptional Hosted API concession
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cloudsage.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + draft commercial for CloudSage high-volume pilot

Elena — great speaking this morning. As discussed, attached is a draft master agreement and a commercial term sheet for the 12-month pilot your team proposed. Key points:

- Pilot start: June 1, 2028
- Expected average monthly tokens (prod): ~2.1B tokens/month first quarter, ramp to ~3.8B/month by Q4
- Proposed list pricing: standard Hosted API rates (per-token)
- CloudSage request: a one-time tiered concession reaching 32% off list at committed levels

We can support a meaningful concession if we secure a firm monthly committed spend and a 12-month term. Marissa is copied — she can summarize the ask for our internal approval flow. Please confirm the exact commitment (MB/month) your procurement team will sign and whether you need DocuSign on the MA.

Attachments: CloudSage_MAProposal_v3.pdf, usage_forecast_Q3_Q4.xlsx

Best,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-22T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + draft commercial for CloudSage high-volume pilot

Ben — thanks, got it. Summary for internal review: CloudSage (Series B, ML platform) is asking for a structured concession that hits 32% off list at their target committed throughput. They have strong volume visibility but need the rate to justify internal economics for their product launch.

Initial ask from Deal Desk: please provide:
- Expected committed spend per month (dollar) and minimum throughput guarantee (tokens/month)
- CAC / expected onboarding credits needed (they asked about free pilot credits)
- Any compliance/region constraints (they requested US data residency)

I think this is an escalation because the requested discount exceeds 20% and materially affects unit economics. Karthik — can you weigh in on what level of concession we can sign off at VP level versus needing exec? I will prep the approval form and include forecasted unit economics and CLTV.

-Marissa
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cloudsage.ai>, CloudSage Procurement <procurement@cloudsage.ai>
Date: 2028-04-22T13:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + draft commercial for CloudSage high-volume pilot

Marissa/Karthik — quick commercial color to inform the approval packet:

- CloudSage is committing to an initial 12-month contract with a minimum monthly spend of $240k (committed tokens ~2.0B/month), plus a 20% growth ramp after 90 days tied to usage thresholds.
- They asked for 32% off list at the committed tier. With our recommended blended approach (commit + overage tiers), discount at commit-level would be 32%, stepping down to 22% for overages up to 50% above commit.
- Economic rationale: if we accept 32% at the commit level we expect ~ $3.1M ARR start and a 12‑month cash flow that accelerates our dedicated/GPU utilization in US west region (fills low-utilized capacity).
- Strategic value: CloudSage is integrated into two major enterprise marketplaces and is pursuing a case study with a Fortune 200 retailer — win could catalyze similar logos.

Attached is a simple P&L model and the revised term sheet (CloudSage_MAProposal_v3.pdf, usage_forecast_Q3_Q4.xlsx). If we need to reduce the concession, I propose we consider: 1) limiting the deep discount to the first 6 months, or 2) requiring an elevated irrevocable commit (prepay or minimum invoice).

Ben
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-23T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + draft commercial for CloudSage high-volume pilot — approval request

Marissa/Ben — I reviewed the materials. Context for execs: the requested 32% concession materially exceeds our standard approval band (20% VP threshold). This looks like a strategic early-customer play with upside (case study + marketplace motion) but it also increases short-term unit cost.

Asking execs for one of two options:
1) Approve up to 25% off list at committed monthly spend of $240k for 12 months, with a required 6-month prepay option (reduces cash risk).
2) Approve the full requested structure (32% commit-level discount, step-down for overage) contingent on legal signoff for explicit ramp protections and a $500k performance reserve (escrow or prepaid credit) to be held for the first 90 days.

Rationales attached in the approval form: expected incremental utilization, comparable strategic concessions we granted in 2027, and break-even token price.

Monica — tagging you for executive review. Given the volume and the timeline (they want DocuSign this week), would you be comfortable approving option 1 or 2?

Karthik
VP, Sales Operations
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-24T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + draft commercial for CloudSage high-volume pilot — approval request

Team — reviewed the deal and the upside. I approve Option 1 with the following mandatory controls:

- Approval: 25% off list at committed monthly spend of $240k for 12 months (this is an exception to standard policy).
- Financial control: CloudSage must prepay the first 3 months (applied to invoices) and provide a credit card or bank guarantee for month 4–12.
- Legal: add a 60-day ramp protection clause (if actual usage is less than 80% of committed tokens over the first 60 days, Redwood can revisit pricing).
- Marketing/Partnership: PR/case-study commitment and joint announcement within 6 months; marketing to be coordinated with Growth.

Please update the MA and term sheet accordingly and send through DocuSign with redlined changes flagged. This approval is limited to the exact structure above; any deviation will require fresh exec sign-off.

Monica Patel
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cloudsage.ai>, CloudSage Procurement <procurement@cloudsage.ai>
Date: 2028-04-24T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudSage high-volume initiative — exec sign-off for exceptional Hosted API concession

Elena / CloudSage procurement — good news: Redwood has approved a strategic concession for your pilot. Approved commercial summary (executive sign-off):

- 25% off list at the committed tier ($240k/mo) for 12 months
- First 3 months prepay required; bank guarantee or CC on file for months 4–12
- 60-day ramp protection clause included in MA
- Joint case study and co-marketing commitment within 6 months

We will send a redlined MA and a DocuSign link shortly. Ben will coordinate signature logistics and logistics for the prepay. Please confirm acceptance of the prepay and timeline for countersignature.

Attachments: redwood_approval_form.docx

Thanks —
Marissa
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
